run_ideal_observer_bot: run an IdealObserverBot episode on the symbolic alchemy environment using precomputed maps and reward weights
run_random_action_bot: run a RandomActionBot episode on the symbolic alchemy environment that selects random stone and potion pairs
replay_trial_actions: replay a sequence of recorded trial actions using ReplayBot on the symbolic alchemy environment
run_symbolic_alchemy_bot: run any symbolic alchemy bot for one full episode given episode items, chemistry, and reward weights
get_multi_trial_ideal_observer_reward: apply a greedy ideal observer policy across multiple trials and return per-trial rewards and event trackers
